task: 11.3 — BKT vs DKT benchmark on a public knowledge-tracing dataset

dataset.name: synthetic-5
dataset.seed_variant_note: 20 seed variants (v0-v19) exist upstream; only v0 was used — not cherry-picked across seeds.
dataset.item_representation: concept id (0-4) from the info file, NOT question id (0-49)
dataset.item_representation_note: This is the representation the production engine uses (mastery per skill, not per question), but it is NOT the paper's setup, which keys on question ids. Handing the model ground-truth concept labels removes within-concept difficulty and makes the task strictly easier for BOTH models — which is why both score above the paper's numbers here. See paper_reference_numbers.

split.method: temporal, by student — original row order preserved, no shuffling
split.note: Step-ahead prediction within every evaluated sequence uses only responses 1..t-1 of that student.

methodology.bkt_fitting: Coarse grid search over 4 global BKTModel parameters (p_l0 in [0.1, 0.3, 0.5], p_t in [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4], p_g in [0.1, 0.2, 0.3], p_s in [0.05, 0.1, 0.2]), selected by AUC on the TRAIN split only. NOT full Baum-Welch/EM. The production BKTModel (app/services/engine/bkt.py) has no parameter-fitting logic at all; grid search was added here only for this benchmark, via the existing public BKTModel(SkillParams) API, to avoid under-fitting the baseline.
methodology.dkt_reuse: app.ml.train_dkt._Net / _DKTDataset / _collate reused unmodified; only the outer train/eval loop is new.

paper_reference_numbers.note: Piech et al. 2015 report these on synthetic-5 with their own split/CV setup AND question-id items. NOT comparable to the AUCs above — see dataset.item_representation_note. These are context for the DKT-over-BKT margin, not a scoreboard: do not report this run as beating the paper.
paper_reference_numbers.margin_note: The margin, not the absolute AUC, is what transfers. It is much smaller here than in the paper: a well-fit BKT is a strong baseline over only 5 concepts, and DKT's edge grows with item-level sparsity that this concept-level variant removes by construction. Defensible claim from this file: 'on concept-level synthetic-5, our DKT beats our grid-fit BKT by ~0.03 AUC.' Nothing stronger.

acceptance_criterion.text: DKT AUC >= 0.70 AND DKT AUC > BKT AUC

assistments_2009.reason: Official distribution page is a Google Sites page with no static/scriptable direct-download URL (file lives behind a client-side-rendered Google Drive link). No working GitHub mirror was found among the candidates probed below.
